bug_semantics: rfapiRibBi2Ri() in bgpd/rfapi/rfapi_rib.c copies a BGP path's VNC sub-TLVs into struct rfapi_info. For BGP_VNC_SUBTLV_TYPE_RFPOPTION it treats pEncap->value[0]/value[1] as an inner type/length and XCALLOC/memcpy's pEncap->length-2 bytes with no check that the sub-TLV is long enough. bgp_attr_encap() will store a VNC sub-TLV of any sublength (including 0/1/2) from a BGP UPDATE; ENABLE_BGP_VNC is on unless --disable-bgp-vnc. A short RFPOPTION then OOBs on value[] (flexible array sized to sublength) and computes length-2 as a negative int (uint16_t promotes) that XCALLOC takes as a huge size_t, or XCALLOC(0) when length==2. Callers rfapiRibPreloadBi/rfapiRibUpdatePendingNode run this on imported VPN/VNC routes, crashing or exhausting bgpd (DoS).
flaw_origin: The unvalidated RFPOPTION copy was first written when the whole rfapi VNC feature landed in 65efcfce427e2abb548874ebb1a11a3b2ee7bc17 (2016-05-07 author Lou Berger, committed 2016-10-03 by Donald Sharp). Parent 520d2512db8496f9b79b917cb84e36b83465f884 has no bgpd/rfapi/ and no RFPOPTION. Later touches only reindent, bgp_info→bgp_path_info rename, and bgp_attr_get_vnc_subtlvs(); they do not rewrite the missing-length logic. The 2026 fix only adds drop-on length<3 and value[1]==0.
